      The list renders .o_colorlist, which the same four tests already assert
      count 1 on the opposite branch. No repo declares a bare .o_colorpicker.

      Carries { message: "modal should have been closed" }; the same test
      drives that dialog through .modal end to end.
  .o_notification_title  client_action.test.js x1
      There is no title element to count -- notification.xml inlines the title
      into .o_notification_content as "<title>. ", so "no title rendered" is
      an assertion about that content's text, which is what it now makes.
